text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I've finally made up my mind. ...For a 
while, I think I'll focus solely on 
working behind the scenes."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The New Year began with a confession like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Strictly behind the scenes, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for springing this on you out 
of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Why did you call me out just to tell me 
that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose you could call it 
encouragement. I just wanted to let you 
know I have high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I already knew of your leadership 
qualities. On top of that, the recent 
Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was astounding. And that's precisely 
why I was certain.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to become the one who guides 
many Umamusume from here on out... You, 
above all others."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a long silence... Sirius Symboli 
lets out a small snort.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Beats me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...You probably thought that once your 
ass slipped backstage, everything would be 
fine as long as you had a substitute, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to tell me. I'm the one 
rising to the top. Anyone who wants to 
follow can just try and keep up.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you wag your tail, I'll pet you. But 
unlike you, I won't feed you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Thank you, Sirius. ...That's a 
relief.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to quietly pray for your 
future success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, I ended up going on the 
first shrine visit of the year with Sirius 
Symboli."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I feel all the expectations on me... 
first and foremost, I just want to push 
relentlessly toward my upcoming venture 
overseas.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Such was the earnest prayer offered up.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Are you finished? Let's head home.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"There's a mountain of things to do. Not 
nearly enough time. For now, today's focus 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, now that I think about it, last 
year I made you choose from three options, 
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Making it a tradition doesn't sound bad 
either. I was just having trouble 
deciding.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
• Sift through the documents • Special 
training • Greet my teacher and old man

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Go ahead, pick one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With many intriguing options catching my 
eye, the one I chose was—
choice_data_list:
"I'm going to greet sensei and my old 
man."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? As expected of an esteemed Tracen 
Academy Trainer, quite the eager student, 
aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You have the materials you gathered, 
right? Have them ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, when we brought together the 
materials each of us had collected—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I collected a decent amount myself, 
but... your stash is downright absurd."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had been collecting them whenever I 
found the time, mostly during summer 
training camp... but it really had become 
an absurd amount.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just how many volumes worth of reference 
material on overseas racetracks are there?
choice_data_list:
I thought it might be necessary to make 
your dream come true...

I thought you might need it to make your 
dream come true...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Learned quite a fancy trick, haven't you? 
...Did you really want your master to pet 
you that badly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, it was a worthwhile time 
spent reorganizing our information once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A few days after that New Year's, Symboli 
Rudolf held a press conference."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've chosen me, wherever I go, 
you'd better follow along without a word, 
got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, what exactly is this 
"special training"? As she changes and 
starts walking, I follow after her—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, that's pretty pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The climb has begun...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pick up the pace. You won't make it in 
time at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by Sirius Symboli's fierce 
encouragement, I somehow manage to reach 
the summit, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A beautiful sunset awaited.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...When I was a kid, my old man and I used 
to gaze out at it until sundown.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sunsets are nice. Unlike sunrises, they 
ain't so loud and annoying.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...The stars will rise soon. The air is 
crisp, so the view shouldn't be half bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius forms a vertex of the Winter 
Triangle. It should be clearly visible 
around this time of year."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
............ I won't stop ya if you wanna 
watch, but I'm getting off.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sirius truly shines once the night grows 
deep. Can you wait that long?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving those words behind, she really did 
head down the mountain.
choice_data_list:
(It'd be nice if the two of us could see 
it together someday.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly chased after her, knowing she 
would never look back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A few days after that New Year's, Symboli 
Rudolf held a press conference."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Got some nerve, don'tcha? You'd better 
behave yourself, got it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of people could they be...? 
Nervously, I followed behind her—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sirius has possessed extraordinary talent 
since she was little. Her current success 
comes as no surprise.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Teacher
text_block_list.text:
She was quick on the uptake and a joy to 
teach. We held nothing back in her 
training.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sirius is our prized treasure. An 
Umamusume raised and polished with utmost 
care.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I was worried about what I'd do if I got 
stuck with a Trainer who couldn't deliver 
results, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the person Sirius chose. 
You are very proper.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be counting on you from here on out 
as well, okay? Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Hahaha! Hey, hey, don't go scaring 
them too much.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, she's an adorable puppy— 
but her fangs are fully grown. And she has 
quite the keen nose, too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: No need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —A little noise just adds to the charm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her suggestions seemed to have earned the 
trust of her father and teacher... We were 
able to spend a warm, harmonious time 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A few days after that New Year's, Symboli 
Rudolf held a press conference."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Does 'focusing solely on 
behind-the-scenes work for the time being' 
mean we won't be able to see you run in 
races anymore?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Supporting an Umamusume from behind the 
scenes is not a task for the half-hearted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I felt that acutely last year. At least 
for now, I have no intention of returning.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf-san, who could be called a hero of 
the current Umamusume world, taking a 
sudden rest... Many fans will surely be 
saddened.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...If I failed to live up to your 
expectations, I am truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, the world I desire is one where 
more Umamusume can challenge races without 
facing heartbreak.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If it is what must be done for that 
purpose, I want to take on the challenge 
without compromise. Above all—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it's an Umamusume who can be called a 
"hero," it doesn't necessarily have to be 
me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Please look forward to seeing what she'll 
accomplish."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're as good at giving speeches as ever. 
Though your suspicious aura still gets on 
my nerves—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you credit for emphasizing the 
vacant slot. Drawing attention is exactly 
what I was hoping for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using the Senior Class as a springboard to 
cross far beyond the sea. I want to race 
through it all by her side.
